params.message:
A trend says the need it serves, on its page and at the agent door

driver_tags on trend cards (one or two of the Standard's drivers, main one first),
stored from the projection. The trend page says what they are after, with the
Standard's definition; the API and MCP carry drivers [{id, label}] on every trend
(contract 1.7.0). Named drivers, not needs: that key already says which plan
opens a depth.
